title.en: Volume 255 Biographies 14: Guo Chong, Yang Tingzhang, Song Wo, Xiang Gong, Wang Yanchao, Zhang Yongde, Wang Quanbin, Kang Yanze, Wang Jitao, Gao Yanhui
title.raw: 卷二百五十五 列傳第十四 郭崇 楊廷璋 宋偓 向拱 王彥超 張永德 王全斌 康延澤 王繼濤 高彥暉 Volume 255 Biographies 14: Guo Chong, Yang Tingzhang, Song Wo, Xiang Gong, Wang Yanchao, Zhang Yongde, Wang Quanbin, Kang Yanze, Wang Jitao, Gao Yanhui

sentences.zh: 郭崇，應州金城人。

translations.literal: Guo Chong was a man of Jincheng in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chong came from Jincheng in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 重厚寡言，有方略。

translations.literal: He was steadfast and taciturn, and possessed strategic ability.
translations.idiomatic: Steadfast and sparing of speech, he had a gift for strategy.

sentences.zh: 初名崇威，避周祖名，止稱崇。

translations.literal: His original name was Chongwei; to avoid the Zhou Founder's taboo name, he was known simply as Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Originally named Chongwei, he dropped the final character to avoid the taboo on the Zhou Founder's name and was known thereafter as Chong alone.

sentences.zh: 父祖俱代北酋長。

translations.literal: His father and grandfather had both been tribal chieftains north of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Both his father and grandfather had been chieftains among the tribes of northern Dai.

sentences.zh: 崇弱冠以勇力應募為卒。

translations.literal: When Chong came of age, he enlisted as a soldier on account of his courage and strength.
translations.idiomatic: At his coming of age, Chong volunteered for service as a common soldier, his courage and strength winning him a place in the ranks.

sentences.zh: 後唐清泰中。

translations.literal: During the Qingtai era of Later Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qingtai reign of Later Tang,

sentences.zh: 為應州騎軍都校。

translations.literal: He served as commander of the cavalry corps of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was made commander of the Ying Prefecture cavalry.

sentences.zh: 晉祖割雲應地入為契丹，崇恥事之，奮身南歸，曆鄆、河中、潞三鎮騎軍都校。

translations.literal: When the Jin Founder ceded the Yun and Ying territories and entered Khitan service, Chong was ashamed to serve them; he threw himself southward to return and successively served as commander of the cavalry corps in the three garrisons of Yan, Hezhong, and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin Founder surrendered the Yun and Ying region to the Khitans and submitted to them, Chong refused to serve under foreign rule. He made his way south and, over time, held command of the mounted corps at Yan, Hezhong, and Lu.

sentences.zh: 開運中，戍太原。

translations.literal: During the Kaiyun era, he garrisoned Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyun period he was posted to garrison Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 會漢祖起義，以崇為前鋒。

translations.literal: When the Han Founder rose in rebellion, Chong was made vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zhiyuan raised the banner of revolt, Chong was appointed to lead the van.

sentences.zh: 入汴，改護聖左第六軍都校、領郢州刺史，改領富州。

translations.literal: Upon entering Bian, he was changed to commander of the Left Sixth Army of the Imperial Guard, given the governorship of E Prefecture, then transferred to Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After the army entered Bian, he was made commander of the Left Sixth Army of the Imperial Guard, given E Prefecture to govern, and soon after reassigned to Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 從周祖平河中，以功遷果州防禦使、領護聖右廂都指揮使。

translations.literal: Following the Zhou Founder in pacifying Hezhong, for merit he was promoted to defensive commissioner of Guo Prefecture and commander of the right wing of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Zhou Founder in the pacification of Hezhong and, for his service, was promoted to defensive commissioner of Guo Prefecture and given command of the Imperial Guard's right wing.

sentences.zh: 周祖鎮鄴，以崇領行營騎軍兼天雄軍都巡檢使。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Founder held garrison at Ye, Chong was put in charge of the campaign cavalry and concurrently made commander-inspector of the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: While the Zhou Founder held his base at Ye, Chong was placed in charge of the campaign cavalry and concurrently made inspector-general of the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 乾祐三年冬，崇從周祖平國難，與李筠拒慕容彥超於劉子陂，走之，以崇補侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Qianyou, Chong followed the Zhou Founder in quelling the national crisis; with Li Jun he resisted Murong Yanchao at Liuzipo, drove him off, and Chong was appointed to fill the post of commander of the Palace Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianyou 3, Chong marched with the Zhou Founder to settle the dynastic crisis. With Li Jun he met Murong Yanchao at Liuzipo, put him to flight, and was then appointed commander of the Palace Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 遣馮道等迎湘陰公贇於徐州，將立之。

translations.literal: Feng Dao and others were dispatched to welcome the Duke of Xiangyin, Yun, at Xuzhou, intending to install him as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dao and others were sent to Xuzhou to escort the Duke of Xiangyin, Yun, back to the throne.

sentences.zh: 會契丹南侵，周祖北征，次於澶州，為六軍推戴。

translations.literal: When the Khitans invaded south, the Zhou Founder marched north on campaign, halted at Cangzhou, and was acclaimed by the six armies.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the Khitans swept south. The Zhou Founder marched north, halted at Cangzhou, and was raised up by acclamation of the six armies.

sentences.zh: 樞密使王峻在京師聞變，遣崇率七百騎東拒贇，遇於睢陽。

translations.literal: The palace commissioner Wang Jun, hearing of the change in the capital, dispatched Chong with seven hundred horsemen east to resist Yun; they met at Suiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun, the palace commissioner, learned of the upheaval in the capital and sent Chong east with seven hundred horsemen to block Yun. They met at Suiyang.

sentences.zh: 崇陣於牙門外，贇懼，登門樓呼崇曰：“汝等何遽至此？

translations.literal: Chong drew up his array outside the gate; Yun was afraid, climbed the gate tower, and called down to Chong, saying, "Why have you come so hastily?
translations.idiomatic: Chong formed his ranks outside the gate. Yun, frightened, mounted the gate tower and called down to him: "Why have you come in such haste?

sentences.zh: ”崇曰：“澶州軍變，遣崇等來衛乘輿，非有他也。

translations.literal: " Chong said, "There was a mutiny in the army at Cangzhou; we were sent to guard the imperial carriage—nothing else.
translations.idiomatic: " Chong replied, "The army at Cangzhou has mutinied. We were sent only to protect the imperial carriage—nothing more.

sentences.zh: ”贇召崇升樓，崇未敢登，即遣道下與語，崇乃登，具言軍情有屬，天命已定，贇執崇手泣，俯首久之。

translations.literal: " Yun summoned Chong to ascend the tower; Chong did not dare go up, so he sent Dao down to speak with him; only then did Chong ascend and fully explain that military sentiment had its allegiance and the Mandate was already settled. Yun grasped Chong's hand and wept, bowing his head a long while.
translations.idiomatic: " Yun summoned Chong to the tower, but Chong did not dare climb up. He sent Feng Dao down to speak with him first; only then did Chong ascend and explain in full that the army's loyalty was already decided and Heaven's Mandate had been settled. Yun took Chong's hand and wept, his head bowed for a long while.

sentences.zh: 俄而贇所領衛兵都校張令超以眾歸崇，贇親將賈、王等數怒目視道，將害之。

translations.literal: Before long Zhang Lingchao, commander of the guard troops Yun led, came over to Chong with his men. Yun's personal generals Jia, Wang, and several others glared angrily at Dao, intending to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhang Lingchao, commander of the guard under Yun's command, defected to Chong with his troops. Several of Yun's own officers—Jia, Wang, and others—fixed furious stares on Feng Dao, ready to kill him.

sentences.zh: 贇曰：“汝輩勿草草，此非關令公事。

translations.literal: Yun said, "You must not act rashly—this has nothing to do with Master Lingchao's business.
translations.idiomatic: Yun said, "Do not be rash. This has nothing to do with Master Feng.

sentences.zh: ”崇即送贇就館舍。

translations.literal: " Chong immediately escorted Yun to his lodging.
translations.idiomatic: " Chong at once escorted Yun to his quarters.

sentences.zh: 廣順初，領定武軍節度，又為京城都巡檢使、修城都部署兼知步軍公事。

translations.literal: At the start of Guangshun, he held the Dingwu military governorship, also served as capital inspector-in-chief, director of fortification works, and overseer of foot army affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Guangshun era he was made military governor of Dingwu, capital inspector-in-chief, director of the capital fortification effort, and overseer of foot-soldier affairs.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復升陳州為節鎮，以潁州隸焉，命崇為節度。

translations.literal: Before long Chen Prefecture was again elevated to a circuit garrison, Ying Prefecture was placed under it, and Chong was appointed military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, Chen Prefecture was raised again to a full military governorship, with Ying Prefecture placed under its jurisdiction, and Chong was appointed to command it.

sentences.zh: 周祖親郊，加同平章事，出鎮澶州。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Founder personally performed the suburban sacrifice, Chong was given the additional title of Tongpingzhangshi and sent out to govern Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Founder performed the suburban sacrifice in person, Chong was made Tongpingzhangshi and sent out to govern Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 周祖不豫，促還鎮所。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Founder fell ill, he was urgently recalled to his post.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Founder fell gravely ill, Chong was urgently recalled to his command.

sentences.zh: 世宗立，幷人侵潞州，命崇與符彥卿出固鎮以禦之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, the Bian people invaded Luzhou; Chong was ordered with Fu Yanqing to go out from Guzhen to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Shizong took the throne, the armies of Bingzhou invaded Luzhou. Chong and Fu Yanqing were ordered to march out from Guzhen to meet them.

sentences.zh: 世宗親征，又副彥卿為行營都部署。

translations.literal: When Shizong personally campaigned, Chong again served as deputy to Yanqing as campaign headquarters commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong led the campaign in person, Chong again served under Yanqing as deputy commander of the field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 師還，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was given the additional title of Palace Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he returned with the additional rank of Palace Counselor.

sentences.zh: 冬，移真定尹、成德軍世度。

translations.literal: In winter he was made governor of Zhending and military governor of the Chengde Army.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was transferred to serve as governor of Zhending and military governor of Chengde.

sentences.zh: 四年，世宗征淮南，契丹出騎萬乘餘掠邊，崇率師攻下束鹿縣，斬數百級，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when Shizong campaigned against Huainan, the Khitans sent more than ten thousand cavalry to raid the frontier; Chong led troops and captured Shulu County, beheading several hundred and taking very many captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, while Shizong campaigned against Huainan, the Khitans sent more than ten thousand horsemen to raid the border. Chong led his forces against them, took Shulu County, and killed several hundred while capturing a great many more.

sentences.zh: 五年，天清節，崇來朝，表求致政，不允，賜襲衣、金帶、器幣、鞍勒馬，遣之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on the Tianqing Festival, Chong came to court and memorialized requesting retirement; it was not granted, and he was given court robes, a gold belt, vessels and silk, saddle and bridled horses, and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the Tianqing Festival, Chong came to court and asked to retire. The request was denied, but he was lavished with court robes, a gold belt, ritual vessels, silk, and a saddled horse before being sent home.

sentences.zh: 世宗平關南，至靜安軍，崇來朝。

translations.literal: When Shizong pacified Guannan and reached Jing'an Army, Chong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong completed the pacification of Guannan and reached Jing'an Army, Chong came to court.

sentences.zh: 恭帝嗣位，加檢校太師。

translations.literal: When the Gong Emperor succeeded, he was given the additional title of Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: After the Gong Emperor succeeded to the throne, he was given the additional title of Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 宋初，加兼中書令。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, he was given the additional title of Concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the Song dynasty, he was given the additional title of Concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 崇追感周室恩遇，時復泣下。

translations.literal: Chong, recalling his debt of gratitude to the Zhou house, would from time to time weep.
translations.idiomatic: Chong, moved by remembrance of the Zhou court's kindness to him, would sometimes weep openly.

sentences.zh: 監軍陳思誨密奏其狀，因言：“常山近邊，崇有異心，宜謹備之。

translations.literal: The supervising commissioner Chen Sihui secretly memorialized on his condition, adding, "Changshan is near the frontier; Chong has ulterior intent and should be guarded against carefully.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising commissioner Chen Sihui secretly reported what he had seen and added, "Changshan lies close to the border, and Chong may harbor disloyal intent. We should watch him carefully.

sentences.zh: ”太祖曰：“我素知崇篤於恩義，蓋有所激發爾。

translations.literal: " The Founding Emperor said, "I have always known Chong is devoted to gratitude and righteousness—it must be that something provoked this.
translations.idiomatic: " The Founding Emperor replied, "I have always known Chong to be deeply loyal. Something must have stirred these feelings.

sentences.zh: ”遣人覘之，還言崇方對賓屬坐池潭小亭飲博，城中晏然。

translations.literal: " He sent someone to spy on him; the spy returned and reported that Chong was just seated with his guests drinking and gambling in a small pavilion by the pool, and the city was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent a man to observe him in secret. The spy returned and reported that Chong was at that moment drinking and gambling with his guests in a small pavilion by the pool, and the city was perfectly calm.

sentences.zh: 太祖笑曰：“果如朕言。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor laughed and said, "Just as I said.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor laughed. "It is exactly as I said,

sentences.zh: ”未幾來朝。

translations.literal: " Before long he came to court.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long Chong came to court.

sentences.zh: 時命李重進為平盧軍節度，重進叛，改命崇為節制。

translations.literal: At the time Li Chongjin had been appointed military governor of the Pinglu Army; when Chongjin rebelled, Chong was reassigned to that post.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chongjin had just been appointed military governor of Pinglu when he rebelled. Chong was then reassigned to take his place.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年，卒，年五十八。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiande, he died at age fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 3 he died at the age of fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 太祖聞之震悼，贈太師。

translations.literal: Hearing of it, the Founding Emperor was shaken with grief and posthumously enfeoffed him Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founding Emperor heard the news, he was stricken with grief and posthumously enfeoffed Chong as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 子守璘至洛苑副使，妻即明德皇后之姊也。

translations.literal: His son Shoulin reached vice-director of the Luoyuan; his wife was the elder sister of Empress Mingde.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shoulin rose to vice-director of the Luoyuan, and his wife was the elder sister of Empress Mingde.

sentences.zh: 子允恭，以父任授殿直，至崇儀副使、知常州卒。

translations.literal: His son Yonggong, through his father's position, was given the post of palace attendant; he reached vice-commissioner of the Imperial Ceremonial and died while governing Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yonggong entered service through his father's privilege as a palace attendant, rose to vice-commissioner of the Imperial Ceremonial, and died while governing Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 次女為仁宗皇后。

translations.literal: A younger daughter became Empress of Emperor Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: A younger daughter became Empress to Emperor Renzong.

sentences.zh: 天聖三年，詔贈崇尚書令兼中書令，守璘太尉、寧國軍節度，允恭太傅、安德軍節度。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiansheng, an edict posthumously enfeoffed Chong as Director of the Department of State Affairs and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat; Shoulin as Grand Marshal and military governor of the Ningguo Army; Yonggong as Grand Tutor and military governor of the Ande Army.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiansheng 3 an edict posthumously enfeoffed Chong as Director of the Department of State Affairs and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat; Shoulin as Grand Marshal and military governor of Ningguo; and Yonggong as Grand Tutor and military governor of Ande.

sentences.zh: 六年，又詔追封崇英國公，加贈守璘康清軍節度兼中書令，允恭忠武軍節度兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, another edict posthumously enfeoffed Chong as Duke of Ying; Shoulin was additionally given the Qing military governorship and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat; Yonggong the Zhongwu military governorship and Concurrent Vice Grand Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year another edict posthumously enfeoffed Chong as Duke of Ying, gave Shoulin the additional titles of military governor of Kangqing and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and made Yonggong military governor of Zhongwu and Concurrent Vice Grand Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 允恭子中庸，左侍禁、閣門祗候、副使；

translations.literal: Yonggong's son Zhongyong reached left attendant of the guard, gate usher, and deputy commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Yonggong's son Zhongyong rose to left attendant of the guard, gate usher, and deputy commissioner;

sentences.zh: 中和，娶潁川郡王德彝女，為西染院副使。

translations.literal: Zhonghe married the daughter of Wang Deyi, Prince of Yingchuan, and became deputy director of the West Dyeing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe took as his wife the daughter of Wang Deyi, Prince of Yingchuan, and served as deputy director of the West Dyeing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 楊廷璋

translations.literal: Yang Tingzhang
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tingzhang

sentences.zh: 楊廷璋，字溫玉，真定人。

translations.literal: Yang Tingzhang, courtesy name Wenyu, was a native of Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tingzhang, styled Wenyu, was a native of Zhending.

sentences.zh: 家世素微賤，有姊寡居京師，周祖微時，欲聘之，姊不從，令媒氏傳言恐逼，姊以告廷璋。

translations.literal: His family had always been humble and lowly. He had an elder sister widowed and living in the capital; when the Zhou Founder was still obscure, he wished to marry her. The sister refused; he had the matchmaker transmit threats of compulsion, and the sister told Tingzhang.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been poor and low in status. He had an elder sister, widowed and living in the capital. When the Zhou Founder was still unknown, he sought to marry her. She refused, but he had the matchmaker threaten coercion, and she told Tingzhang.

sentences.zh: 廷璋往見周祖，歸謂姊曰：“此人姿貌異常，不可拒。

translations.literal: Tingzhang went to see the Zhou Founder; returning home he told his sister, "This man's appearance is extraordinary—he must not be refused.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang went to see the Zhou Founder for himself. When he returned he told his sister, "This man's bearing is unlike any other. You must not refuse him.

sentences.zh: ”姊乃從之。

translations.literal: " The sister then consented.
translations.idiomatic: " His sister then agreed.

sentences.zh: 周祖從漢祖鎮太原，廷璋屢省其姊，周祖愛其純謹。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Founder followed the Han Founder in garrisoning Taiyuan, Tingzhang often visited his sister; the Zhou Founder cherished his pure and careful ways.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Founder followed the Han Founder to garrison Taiyuan, Tingzhang often visited his sister. The Zhou Founder came to value his plain, careful character.

sentences.zh: 姊卒，留廷璋給事左右。

translations.literal: When the sister died, Tingzhang was kept to attend at his side.
translations.idiomatic: After his sister died, Tingzhang was kept on to serve at the Zhou Founder's side.

sentences.zh: 及出討三叛，入平國難，廷璋數獻奇計。

translations.literal: When he went out to suppress the three rebellions and entered to pacify the national crisis, Tingzhang several times offered ingenious plans.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Founder marched out against the three rebellions and returned to settle the dynastic crisis, Tingzhang offered ingenious plans again and again.

sentences.zh: 即位，追冊廷璋姊為淑妃，擢廷璋為右飛龍使，廷璋固辭不拜，願推恩其父洪裕。

translations.literal: Upon accession, Tingzhang's sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Shufei; Tingzhang was promoted to Right Feilong Commissioner. Tingzhang firmly declined, wishing instead that favor be extended to his father Hongyu.
translations.idiomatic: Upon taking the throne, the Zhou Founder posthumously enfeoffed Tingzhang's sister as Shufei and promoted Tingzhang to Right Feilong Commissioner. Tingzhang firmly declined the appointment and asked that favor be extended instead to his father Hongyu.

sentences.zh: 即令召洪裕赴闕，以老病辭，就拜金紫光祿大夫、真定少尹。

translations.literal: He was immediately ordered to summon Hongyu to court; citing old age and illness, Hongyu declined and was given the gold-belted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and acting governor of Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyu was summoned to court at once, but pleaded old age and illness and declined to come. He was instead invested as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the gold belt and given the post of acting governor of Zhending.

sentences.zh: 廷璋曆皇城使、昭義兵馬都監、澶州巡檢使。

translations.literal: Tingzhang successively served as imperial city commissioner, director of Bingmas of Zhaoyi, and inspector of Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang served in turn as imperial city commissioner, director of Bingmas for Zhaoyi, and inspector of Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 世宗自澶淵還京，言廷璋有幹材，遷客省使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong returned from Chanyuan to the capital, he spoke of Tingzhang's administrative talent and promoted him to guest commissioner of state.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong returned from Chanyuan to the capital, he praised Tingzhang's administrative ability and promoted him to guest commissioner of state.

sentences.zh: 俄為河陽巡檢、知州事。

translations.literal: Shortly he became inspector of Heyang and acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he became inspector of Heyang and acting governor.

sentences.zh: 涇帥史懿稱疾不朝，周祖命廷璋往代之。

translations.literal: Shi Yi, military governor of Jing, claimed illness and did not come to court; the Zhou Founder ordered Tingzhang to go replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yi, military governor of Jing, feigned illness and refused to come to court. The Zhou Founder ordered Tingzhang to go and replace him.

sentences.zh: 將行，謂之曰：“懿不就命，即圖之。

translations.literal: As he was about to depart, the Founder told him, "If Yi does not accept the appointment, then eliminate him.
translations.idiomatic: As Tingzhang was about to leave, the Founder told him, "If Yi will not obey the order, remove him.

sentences.zh: ”廷璋至，屏左右，以詔書示懿，諭以禍福，懿即日載路。

translations.literal: " When Tingzhang arrived, he dismissed those around him, showed Yi the edict, and explained fortune and misfortune; Yi that very day departed on the road.
translations.idiomatic: " When Tingzhang arrived, he dismissed his attendants, showed Yi the imperial edict, and explained the consequences. Yi set out that very day.

sentences.zh: 俄聞周主崩，廷璋嘔血不食者數日。

translations.literal: Before long he heard the Zhou lord had died; Tingzhang vomited blood and ate nothing for several days.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he heard that the Zhou emperor had died. Tingzhang vomited blood and ate nothing for days.

sentences.zh: 世宗立，拜左驍衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, he was made Left Xiaowei Grand General and commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After Shizong took the throne, he was appointed Left Xiaowei Grand General and commissioner of the North Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 征劉崇，以為建雄軍節度。

translations.literal: Campaigning against Liu Chong, he was made military governor of the Jianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Liu Chong he was made military governor of the Jianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 在鎮數年，頗有惠愛。

translations.literal: During several years in his post, he showed considerable benevolence and care.
translations.idiomatic: Over several years in command he showed real benevolence toward the people under his rule.

sentences.zh: 前後率兵入太原境，拔仁義、高壁等砦，獲刺史、軍校數十人，俘其民數千戶，獲兵器羊馬數萬計。

translations.literal: Before and after he led troops into Taiyuan territory, captured the forts of Renyi and Gaobi, took several tens of prefects and military officers, captured several thousand households of the enemy people, and obtained weapons, sheep, and horses numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly he led troops into Taiyuan territory, took the forts at Renyi and Gaobi, captured dozens of prefectural officials and military officers, seized several thousand enemy households, and took weapons, sheep, and horses by the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 幷人棄沁州二百里，退保新城，廷璋遂置保安、興同、白壁等十餘砦。

translations.literal: The Bian people abandoned Qin Prefecture for two hundred li, retreated to guard Xincheng, and Tingzhang then established more than ten forts including Bao'an, Xingtong, and Baibi.
translations.idiomatic: The Bingzhou armies withdrew two hundred li from Qin Prefecture and fell back on Xincheng. Tingzhang then established more than ten fortified posts, among them Bao'an, Xingtong, and Baibi.

sentences.zh: 會隰州刺史孫議卒，廷璋遣監軍李謙溥領州事。

translations.literal: When the governor of Xi Prefecture Sun Yi died, Tingzhang sent the supervising commissioner Li Qianbo to take charge of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun Yi, governor of Xi Prefecture, died, Tingzhang sent the supervising commissioner Li Qianbo to take charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 謙溥至，幷人來攻其城，議者以為宜速救之。

translations.literal: When Qianbo arrived, the Bian people came to attack the city; opinion held that a rapid rescue was appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: When Qianbo arrived, the Bingzhou armies came to attack the city. Many argued that a swift rescue was needed.

sentences.zh: 廷璋曰：“隰州城壁堅完，幷人奄至，未能為攻城具，當出奇以破之。

translations.literal: Tingzhang said, "The walls of Xi Prefecture are strong and complete; the Bian people arrived suddenly and cannot yet make siege equipment—we should use surprise to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang said, "Xi Prefecture's walls are strong and intact. The enemy arrived suddenly and cannot yet have prepared siege engines. We should defeat them by surprise.

sentences.zh: ”乃募敢死士百餘人，許以重賞，由間道遣人約謙溥為內應。

translations.literal: " He then recruited more than a hundred dare-to-die soldiers, promised them rich rewards, and sent men by a secret path to arrange with Qianbo for an inside response.
translations.idiomatic: " He then recruited more than a hundred volunteers willing to die for the cause, promised them rich rewards, and sent men by hidden paths to arrange an inside response with Qianbo.

sentences.zh: 既至，即銜枚夜擊，城中鼓噪以出，幷人大潰，追北數十里，斬首千餘級，獲器甲萬計。

translations.literal: When they arrived, they took twigs in their mouths and struck by night; the city sounded drums and clamor sallying forth; the Bian people were routed in great disorder; pursuing north several tens of li, they beheaded more than a thousand and captured armor and weapons numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: When the relief force arrived, the men marched with twigs clenched between their teeth and attacked by night. The city erupted in drums and shouts as the garrison sallied forth. The Bingzhou army broke in complete rout. Pursuing them north for dozens of li, they took more than a thousand heads and captured armor and weapons by the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 奏至，世宗喜曰：“吾舅真能禦寇。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, Shizong said with delight, "My uncle by marriage can truly repel invaders.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached court, Shizong said with delight, "My uncle by marriage truly knows how to repel invaders.

sentences.zh: ”詔褒之。

translations.literal: " An edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict was issued praising him.

sentences.zh: 世宗自河東還，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: When Shizong returned from Hedong, he was given the additional title of Grand Master of Defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong returned from Hedong, Tingzhang was given the additional title of Grand Master of Defense.

sentences.zh: 顯德六年夏，率所部入河東界，下堡砦十三，降巡檢使靳漢晁等三人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xiande, summer, he led his command into the Hedong border, took down thirteen forts and fortresses, and received the surrender of three men including the inspector Han Chao.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Xiande 6 he led his command into the Hedong border, captured thirteen forts and strongpoints, and received the surrender of three men including the inspector Jin Hanchao.

sentences.zh: 恭帝即位，加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: When the Gong Emperor succeeded, he was given the additional title of Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: After the Gong Emperor succeeded, he received the additional rank of Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 宋初，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, he was given the additional title of Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the Song dynasty, he was given the additional title of Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 吏民詣闕，請立碑頌功德。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners came to court requesting a stele to praise his merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials and commoners came to court asking that a stele be erected to praise his merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 太祖命盧多遜撰文賜之。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor ordered Lu Duoxun to compose the text and bestow it.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor ordered Lu Duoxun to compose the inscription and bestow it upon them.

sentences.zh: 李筠叛，潛遣親信使齎蠟書求援鄰境，廷璋獲之，械送京師，因上攻取之策，即下詔委以經略。

translations.literal: When Li Jun rebelled, he secretly sent a trusted envoy bearing a sealed letter seeking aid from neighboring territory; Tingzhang captured him, shackled him and sent him to the capital, and moreover presented a plan for attacking and taking the rebel; an edict was immediately issued entrusting him with overall strategy.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jun rebelled, he secretly sent a trusted envoy with a sealed letter seeking aid from neighboring territories. Tingzhang captured the man, sent him in chains to the capital, and submitted a plan for taking the rebel stronghold. An edict was immediately issued entrusting him with overall command of the campaign.

sentences.zh: 及車駕親征，詔廷璋率所部入陰地，分賊勢。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally campaigned, an edict ordered Tingzhang to lead his command into Yindi to divide the rebel force.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor led the campaign in person, an edict ordered Tingzhang to lead his troops into Yindi to split the rebel force.

sentences.zh: 賊平，歸鎮。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were suppressed, he returned to his command.

sentences.zh: 是秋來朝，改鎮邠州。

translations.literal: That autumn he came to court and was transferred to govern Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn he presented himself at court and was reassigned to govern Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乾德四年，移鄜州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qiande, he was moved to Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 4 he was transferred to Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開寶二年，召為右千牛衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaibao, he was summoned as Right Qianniuwei Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 2 he was recalled to serve as Right Qianniuwei Grand General.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒，年六十。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he died at age sixty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died at the age of sixty.

sentences.zh: 賻帛二百匹。

translations.literal: Two hundred bolts of silk were granted as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted two hundred bolts of silk as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 廷璋美髯，長上短下，好修容儀，雖見小吏，未嘗懈惰。

translations.literal: Tingzhang had a beautiful beard, long above and short below; he liked to attend to his appearance; even when seeing junior clerks, he was never slack or lazy.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang wore a handsome beard, long above and short below, and took care with his appearance. Even when receiving the lowliest clerk he never slackened his bearing.

sentences.zh: 善待士，幕府多知名人。

translations.literal: He treated scholars well; his staff had many famous men.
translations.idiomatic: He treated scholars generously, and many well-known men served in his staff.

sentences.zh: 在晉州日，太祖命荊罕儒為鈐轄。

translations.literal: During his days at Jin Prefecture, the Founding Emperor appointed Jing Hanru as controller.
translations.idiomatic: While he governed Jin Prefecture, the Founding Emperor appointed Jing Hanru as his controller.

sentences.zh: 罕儒以廷璋周朝近親，疑有異志，每入府中，從者皆持刀劍，欲圖廷璋。

translations.literal: Hanru, because Tingzhang was a close relative of the Zhou court, suspected disloyal intent; each time he entered the headquarters, his followers all carried swords to kill Tingzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Because Tingzhang was a close kinsman of the former Zhou house, Hanru suspected treacherous intent. Each time he entered the headquarters his attendants carried swords, ready to kill Tingzhang.

sentences.zh: 廷璋推誠待之，殊不設備，罕儒亦不敢發，終亦無患。

translations.literal: Tingzhang treated him with full sincerity and made no special precautions; Hanru also did not dare act, and in the end there was no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang treated him with complete sincerity and took no special precautions. Hanru in turn did not dare act, and in the end no harm came of it.

sentences.zh: 議者以廷璋在涇州保全史懿，陰德之報也。

translations.literal: Opinion held that Tingzhang's preservation of Shi Yi at Jing Prefecture was the reward of hidden virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Many held that Tingzhang's sparing of Shi Yi at Jing Prefecture was the reward of hidden virtue.

sentences.zh: 洪裕少時，嘗漁於境貂裘陂，忽有馳騎至者，以二石雁授洪裕，一翼掩左，一翼掩右，曰：“吾北嶽使者也。

translations.literal: When Hongyu was young, he once fished at the Jing Diaoqiu Lake; suddenly a rider came at speed, giving Hongyu two stone geese—one wing covering left, one wing covering right—saying, "I am an envoy of the Northern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: When Hongyu was young he once fished at the Jing Diaoqiu Lake. Suddenly a mounted man came at speed and gave him two stone geese, one wing covering the left and one the right, saying, "I am an envoy of the Northern Peak.

sentences.zh: ”言訖，忽不見。

translations.literal: " When the words ended, he suddenly vanished.
translations.idiomatic: " With those words he vanished.

sentences.zh: 是年生淑妃，明年生廷璋，家遂昌盛。

translations.literal: That year the Shufei was born; the next year Tingzhang was born, and the family then flourished.
translations.idiomatic: That year the future Shufei was born; the next year Tingzhang was born, and the family thereafter rose to greatness.

sentences.zh: 廷璋子七人，皆不為求官，惟表其孤甥安崇勳得西頭供奉官。

translations.literal: Tingzhang had seven sons; none did he seek office for; he only memorialized for his orphaned nephew An Chongxun to obtain the post of western head palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang had seven sons, yet sought office for none of them. He memorialized only for his orphaned nephew An Chongxun, who was given the post of western head palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 崇勳，後唐樞密使重誨子也。

translations.literal: Chongxun was the son of the Later Tang palace commissioner Chonghui.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxun was the son of the Later Tang palace commissioner An Chonghui.

sentences.zh: 廷璋子坦、塤皆進士及弟。

translations.literal: Tingzhang's sons Tan and Xun both passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Both of Tingzhang's sons, Tan and Xun, attained jinshi rank.

sentences.zh: 坦至屯田員外郎，鹽鐵副使、判官，塤為都官郎中。

translations.literal: Tan reached vice director of the Ministry of Revenue field office, vice commissioner of salt and iron and case officer; Xun was director of the Ministry of Justice office.
translations.idiomatic: Tan rose to vice director of the field office in the Ministry of Revenue and served as vice commissioner of salt and iron and case officer; Xun became director of the Ministry of Justice office.

sentences.zh: 宋偓，河南洛陽人。

translations.literal: Song Wo, a native of Luoyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Song Wo was a native of Luoyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 謙恭下士。

translations.literal: Humble and respectful toward scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He was humble and respectful toward men of learning.

sentences.zh: 祖瑤，唐天德軍節度兼中書令。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yao was military governor of the Tang Tiande Army and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yao had been military governor of the Tang Tiande Army and Concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 父廷浩，尚後唐莊宗女義寧公主，生偓。

translations.literal: His father Tinghao married Princess Yining of Later Tang, daughter of Emperor Zhuangzong, and begot Wo.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tinghao married Princess Yining of Later Tang, a daughter of Emperor Zhuangzong, and from that union Wo was born.

sentences.zh: 廷浩曆石、原、房三州刺史；

translations.literal: Tinghao successively governed Shi, Yuan, and Fang prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Tinghao had governed in turn the prefectures of Shi, Yuan, and Fang;

sentences.zh: 晉初，為汜水關使，張從賓之叛，力戰死之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jin, he was envoy of the Sishui Pass; when Zhang Congbin rebelled, he fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: at the opening of the Jin dynasty he was made envoy of the Sishui Pass. When Zhang Congbin rebelled, he fought fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 偓年十一，以父死事補殿直，遷供奉官。

translations.literal: Wo at age eleven, through his father's death in service, was given the post of palace attendant and promoted to palace officer.
translations.idiomatic: Wo was eleven when, because of his father's death in service, he was given the post of palace attendant and later promoted to palace officer.

sentences.zh: 晉祖嘗事莊宗，每偓母入見，詔令勿拜，因從容謂之曰：“朕於主家誠無所靳，但朝廷多事，府庫空竭，主所知也。

translations.literal: The Jin Founder had once served Zhuangzong; whenever Wo's mother entered audience, he ordered that she need not bow, and spoke to her at ease, saying, "I toward my lord's house truly hold back nothing, but the court has many affairs and the treasury is empty—you know this, my lord.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Founder had once served under Zhuangzong. Whenever Wo's mother came to audience he ordered that she need not bow, and spoke to her gently: "Toward my lord's household I truly withhold nothing, but the court is beset with affairs and the treasury stands empty—as my lord well knows.

sentences.zh: 今主居輦下，薪米為憂，當奉主居西洛以就豐泰。

translations.literal: Now my lord dwells below the imperial carriage where firewood and rice are a worry; you should have my lord dwell in western Luoyang for abundance and peace.
translations.idiomatic: My lord now lives beneath the imperial capital where even firewood and grain are a worry. Let my lord move to western Luoyang, where life is plentiful and secure.

sentences.zh: ”命偓分司就養，敕有司供給，至於醯醢，率有加等。

translations.literal: " He ordered Wo to serve in a separate office and support his mother; he instructed the offices to supply them, even for vinegar and salted meat always granting extra grade.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered Wo to take a separate post and support his mother there, instructing the relevant offices to provide for them— even vinegar and salted meat were supplied above the usual grade.

sentences.zh: 周祖舉兵向闕，時偓在鎮，開門迎謁，周祖深德之。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Founder raised troops toward the capital, Wo was then in his garrison; he opened the gates to welcome and pay respects; the Zhou Founder deeply appreciated this.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Founder marched on the capital, Wo was then in his command. He opened the gates to welcome him and pay his respects, and the Zhou Founder was deeply grateful.

sentences.zh: 偓率所部兵從周祖，至劉子陂，隱帝衛兵悉走投周祖。

translations.literal: Wo led his troops following the Zhou Founder; reaching Liuzipo, the Hidden Emperor's guard soldiers all fled and threw themselves on the Zhou Founder.
translations.idiomatic: Wo led his troops after the Zhou Founder. At Liuzipo the Hidden Emperor's guard soldiers all deserted and threw themselves on the Zhou Founder's side.

sentences.zh: 周祖謂偓曰：“至尊危矣，公近親，可亟去擁衛，無令驚動。

translations.literal: The Zhou Founder said to Wo, "The Supreme Sovereign is in peril—you are a close relative; go quickly to support and guard him, and do not let there be alarm.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou Founder said to Wo, "The emperor is in danger. You are a close kinsman—ride at once to protect him and keep the camp from panic.

sentences.zh: ”偓策馬及御營，軍已亂矣。

translations.literal: " Wo spurred his horse to reach the imperial camp—the army was already in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: " Wo spurred his horse to the imperial camp, but the army was already in chaos.

sentences.zh: 廣順初，丁內艱，服除，授左監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: At the start of Guangshun, he observed mourning for his mother; when mourning ended, he was appointed Left Jianmenwei Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Guangshun he mourned his mother. When the mourning period ended he was appointed Left Jianmenwei Grand General.

sentences.zh: 世宗征淮南，令偓與左龍武統軍趙讚、右神武統軍張彥超、前景州刺史劉建於壽州四面巡檢。

translations.literal: When Shizong campaigned against Huainan, Wo was ordered with Left Dragon Martial commander Zhao Zan, Right Divine Martial commander Zhang Yanchao, and former Jing prefect Liu Jian to inspect on all four sides of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong campaigned against Huainan, Wo was ordered, together with Zhao Zan, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, Zhang Yanchao, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, and the former prefect of Jing, Liu Jian, to conduct inspections on all four sides of Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 師還，以偓為右神武統軍，充行營右廂都排陣使，又為廬州城下副部署。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Wo was made Right Divine Martial commander, serving as right-wing campaign array commander, and also deputy commander below Luz Prefecture walls.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, Wo was made commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, appointed right-wing campaign array commander, and also made deputy commander at the siege of Luz Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吳人大發舟師。

translations.literal: The Wu people massively dispatched a navy.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu armies dispatched a great fleet.

sentences.zh: 次東氵布洲，斷蘇、杭之路。

translations.literal: They anchored at Dongbuzhou, cutting the routes to Su and Hang.
translations.idiomatic: They anchored at Dongbuzhou, severing the routes to Suzhou and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 世宗遣偓領戰艦數百艘襲之，又遣大將慕容延釗率步騎而進，水陸合勢大破之。

translations.literal: Shizong dispatched Wo leading several hundred warships to attack them, also sent the great general Murong Yanzhao leading infantry and cavalry forward; land and water combined force routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong sent Wo with several hundred warships to strike them and dispatched the great general Murong Yanzhao with infantry and cavalry overland. The combined land-and-water force broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 世宗嘗次於野，有虎逼乘輿，偓引弓射之，一發而斃。

translations.literal: Shizong once halted in the wild; a tiger pressed close to the imperial carriage; Wo drew his bow and shot it—one arrow and it was dead.
translations.idiomatic: Once, when Shizong halted in open country, a tiger pressed close to the imperial carriage. Wo drew his bow and shot it dead with a single arrow.

sentences.zh: 及江北諸州悉平，畫江為界。

translations.literal: When all the prefectures north of the Yangzi were pacified, the river was drawn as boundary.
translations.idiomatic: When every prefecture north of the Yangzi had been pacified, the river was fixed as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 世宗駐迎鑾，命偓率舟師三千溯江而上，巡警諸郡。

translations.literal: Shizong halted at Yingluan; he ordered Wo to lead three thousand naval forces upriver to patrol the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong encamped at Yingluan and ordered Wo to lead three thousand ships upriver to patrol the prefectures along the route.

sentences.zh: 師還，復授滑州節制，又移鎮鄧州。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was again given command of Hua Prefecture and was moved to govern Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was again given command of Hua Prefecture and was transferred to govern Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 恭帝即位，加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: When the Gong Emperor succeeded, he was given the additional title of Kaifu Yitong San Si.
translations.idiomatic: After the Gong Emperor succeeded, he was honored with the rank of Kaifu Yitong San Si.

sentences.zh: 宋初，加檢校太師，遣領舟師巡撫江徼，舒州團練使司超副之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, he was given the additional title of Grand Preceptor and sent to lead naval forces to patrol the river frontier; Si Chao, regiment trainer of Shu Prefecture, served as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the Song dynasty he was given the additional title of Grand Preceptor and sent to lead a naval force patrolling the river frontier, with Si Chao, regiment trainer of Shu Prefecture, as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 李重進謀以揚州叛，偓察其狀，飛章以聞。

translations.literal: Li Chongjin plotted to rebel with Yang Prefecture; Wo discerned his condition and sent an urgent memorial to report it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chongjin plotted to rebel from Yang Prefecture. Wo detected the signs and sent an urgent memorial reporting it.

sentences.zh: 太祖令偓屯海陵，以觀重進去就。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor ordered Wo to encamp at Hailing to observe Chongjin's intentions.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor ordered Wo to encamp at Hailing and watch Chongjin's next move.

sentences.zh: 遂從征揚州，為行營排陣使。

translations.literal: He then followed the campaign against Yang Prefecture as campaign array commander.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the campaign against Yang Prefecture as campaign array commander.

sentences.zh: 及平，以功改保信軍節度。

translations.literal: When it was pacified, for merit he was changed to military governor of the Baoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was suppressed he was made military governor of Baoxin for his service.

sentences.zh: 來朝，徙鎮華州。

translations.literal: Coming to court, he was transferred to govern Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He came to court and was transferred to govern Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會鑿池都城南，命偓率舟師數千以習水戰，東駕數臨觀焉。

translations.literal: When a pool was dug south of the capital city, Wo was ordered to lead several thousand naval forces to drill in water warfare; the Eastern Sovereign several times came to observe.
translations.idiomatic: When an artificial lake was dug south of the capital, Wo was ordered to lead several thousand ships in water-combat drills, and the emperor came repeatedly to watch.

sentences.zh: 五年，改忠武軍節度。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was changed to military governor of the Zhongwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Zhongwu military governorship.

sentences.zh: 開寶初，太祖納偓長女為后。

translations.literal: At the start of Kaibao, the Founding Emperor took Wo's eldest daughter as empress.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Kaibao the Founding Emperor took Wo's eldest daughter as empress.

sentences.zh: 偓本名延渥，以父名下字從“水”，開寶初，上言改為偓。

translations.literal: Wo's original name was Yanwo; taking the lower character of his father's name and following "water," at the start of Kaibao he memorialized to change it to Wo.
translations.idiomatic: Wo's original name was Yanwo. Taking the lower character of his father's name and following the water radical, at the opening of Kaibao he memorialized to change it to Wo.

sentences.zh: 三年，徙邠州。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，加同平章事。

translations.literal: At the start of Taiping Xingguo, he was given the additional title of Tongpingzhangshi.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Taiping Xingguo he was given the additional title of Tongpingzhangshi.

sentences.zh: 二年，移定國軍節度。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was moved to military governor of the Dingguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to the Dingguo military governorship.

sentences.zh: 四年，從平太原，又從征幽州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he followed in pacifying Taiyuan and again followed the campaign against You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he took part in the pacification of Taiyuan and again joined the campaign against You Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔偓與尚食使侯昭願領兵萬餘，攻城南面。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wo and food commissioner Hou Zhaoyuan to lead more than ten thousand troops attacking the city's south face.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wo and the food commissioner Hou Zhaoyuan to lead more than ten thousand troops in the assault on the city's southern face.

sentences.zh: 師還歸鎮。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he went back to his command.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，車駕幸大名，召偓詣行在，詔知滄州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year winter, the imperial carriage visited Daming; Wo was summoned to the temporary palace and ordered to govern Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year the emperor visited Daming. Wo was summoned to the temporary palace and ordered to govern Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六年，封邢國公。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was enfeoffed Duke of Xing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was enfeoffed as Duke of Xing.

sentences.zh: 俄遷同州。

translations.literal: Shortly he was transferred to Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was transferred to Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年，又為右衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he again served as Right Guard Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again served as Right Guard Grand General.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，曹彬等北伐，班師，命偓知霸州，歸闕。

translations.literal: During Yongxi, when Cao Bin and others marched north and withdrew, Wo was ordered to govern Ba Prefecture and return to court.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongxi era, after Cao Bin and the others marched north and withdrew, Wo was ordered to govern Ba Prefecture and then return to court.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，卒，年六十四。

translations.literal: In the second year of Duan Gong, he died at age sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In Duan Gong 2 he died at the age of sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 廢朝，贈侍中，諡莊惠，中使護葬。

translations.literal: Court was suspended; he was posthumously enfeoffed Vice Grand Chancellor, given the posthumous name Zhuanghui, and a palace envoy escorted the burial.
translations.idiomatic: Court mourning was observed. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Vice Grand Chancellor, given the posthumous name Zhuanghui, and a palace envoy was sent to oversee the burial.

sentences.zh: 偓，莊宗之外孫，漢祖之婿，女即孝章皇后，近代貴盛，鮮有其比。

translations.literal: Wo was Zhuangzong's maternal grandson, the Han Founder's son-in-law; his daughter was Empress Xiaozhang—among recent generations of noble grandeur, few could compare.
translations.idiomatic: Wo was a grandson of Zhuangzong on his mother's side and a son-in-law of the Han Founder; his daughter became Empress Xiaozhang. In recent memory few families had risen to such eminence.

sentences.zh: 子元靖至供備庫使，元度至供備庫副使，元載、元亨並至左侍禁、閣門祗候。

translations.literal: His sons Yuanjing reached commissioner of the supply bureau; Yuan Du reached vice commissioner; Yuan Zai and Yuan Heng both reached left attendant of the guard and gate ushers.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yuanjing rose to commissioner of the supply bureau; Yuan Du to vice commissioner; Yuan Zai and Yuan Heng both became left attendants of the guard and gate ushers.

sentences.zh: 初，孝章寢疾，語晉國長公主曰：“我瞑目無他憂，惟慮族屬不敦睦，貽笑於人。

translations.literal: Early on, when Xiaozhang was ill in bed, she told the Princess of Jin, "When I close my eyes I have no other worry, only that the clan kindred may not be harmonious and bring laughter upon us.
translations.idiomatic: Long before, as Empress Xiaozhang lay ill, she told the Princess of Jin, "When I close my eyes I shall have no other worry except this: that our clansmen may fail to live in harmony and become a laughingstock to others.

sentences.zh: ”景德中，偓幼子元翰果詣京府，求析家財。

translations.literal: " During Jingde, Wo's youngest son Yuan Han indeed went to the capital prefectural office seeking division of family property.
translations.idiomatic: " In the Jingde era Wo's youngest son Yuan Han did indeed go to the capital prefectural office to demand a division of the family estate.

sentences.zh: 真宗聞之，詔釋勿問，仍諭其族屬務遵先後遺戒焉。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong heard of it and edicted release without punishment, still instructing the clan to strictly observe the former's dying injunction.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong heard of it, he ordered that Yuan Han be released without punishment and instructed the clan to honor the empress's dying injunction.

sentences.zh: 元度子惟簡，為殿直，惟易為奉職。

translations.literal: Yuan Du's sons Wei Jian were palace attendants; Wei Yi were servitors.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Du's sons Wei Jian and Wei Yi served as palace attendant and servitor respectively.

sentences.zh: 向拱，字星民，懷州河內人。

translations.literal: Xiang Gong, courtesy name Xingmin, was a native of Heyang in Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Gong, styled Xingmin, was a native of Heyang in Huai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 始名訓，避周恭帝諱改焉。

translations.literal: His original name was Xun; he changed it to avoid the Gong Emperor's taboo.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Xun; he changed it to avoid the taboo on the Gong Emperor's name.

sentences.zh: 少倜儻負氣。

translations.literal: In youth he was free-spirited and proud of spirit.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was bold, unconventional, and proud of spirit.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，聞漢祖在晉陽招致天下士，將往依之。

translations.literal: At coming of age, hearing the Han Founder at Jinyang was recruiting men of talent from the realm, he was about to go rely on him.
translations.idiomatic: At his coming of age he heard that the Han Founder at Jinyang was gathering men of talent from across the realm, and he set out to join him.

sentences.zh: 中途遇盜，見拱狀貌雄偉，意為富家子，隨之，將劫其財。

translations.literal: Midway he encountered bandits; seeing Gong's imposing appearance, they thought him a rich man's son, followed him, intending to rob his wealth.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he met bandits. Seeing Gong's imposing build, they took him for a rich man's son, followed him, and planned to rob him.

sentences.zh: 拱覺，行至石會關，殺所乘驢，市酒會里中豪傑，告其故，咸出丁壯護拱至太原。

translations.literal: Gong realized it; reaching Shihui Pass, he killed the donkey he rode, bought wine and gathered local bold fellows, told them the reason, and all sent stalwart youths to escort Gong to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gong realized what they intended. At Shihui Pass he slaughtered the donkey he rode, bought wine, and gathered the local bold fellows. When he told them what had happened, they all sent strong young men to escort him safely to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 以策干漢祖，漢祖不納，客於周祖門下。

translations.literal: He presented his plan to the Han Founder; the Han Founder did not accept it; he became a client at the Zhou Founder's door.
translations.idiomatic: He offered his plans to the Han Founder, but the Han Founder would not take him on. He then became a client at the Zhou Founder's door.

sentences.zh: 及周祖領節鎮，署拱知客押牙。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Founder held a circuit garrison, he appointed Gong chief guest sergeant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Founder received a circuit command, he appointed Gong chief guest sergeant.

sentences.zh: 會延州高允權卒，其寺紹基欲求繼襲，即自領使務。

translations.literal: When the Yanzhou commissioner Gao Yunquan died, his nephew Shaoji wished to succeed and immediately assumed command of the commissioner's affairs himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Yunquan, commissioner of Yanzhou, died, his nephew Shaoji sought to succeed him and at once took command of the commissioner's affairs himself.

sentences.zh: 朝廷益禁兵戍守，命拱權知州事，俄遷內客省使。

translations.literal: The court increased forbidden troops for garrison; Gong was ordered acting governor; shortly he was promoted to inner guest commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The court increased the garrison of forbidden troops and ordered Gong to serve as acting governor. Soon after he was promoted to inner guest commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘗請禁州民賣軍裝兵器於西人，從之。

translations.literal: He once requested forbidding prefecture people from selling military gear and weapons to western barbarians; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He once petitioned to forbid the people of the prefecture from selling military gear and weapons to the western tribes, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 所屬部落有侵盜漢戶者，拱招其酋帥犒之，令誓不敢侵犯。

translations.literal: Among subordinate tribes there were those who robbed Han households; Gong summoned their chieftains and feasted them, ordering them to swear never to invade.
translations.idiomatic: When tribes under his jurisdiction robbed Han households, Gong summoned their chieftains, feasted them, and made them swear never to raid again.

sentences.zh: 召拜左神武大將軍、宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Left Shenwu Grand General and commissioner of the South Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled and appointed Left Shenwu Grand General and commissioner of the South Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 劉崇入寇，遣馬軍樊愛能、步軍何徽赴澤州，令拱監護之。

translations.literal: When Liu Chong invaded, Fan Aineng's cavalry and He Hui's infantry were dispatched to Ze Prefecture; Gong was ordered to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Chong invaded, Fan Aineng's cavalry and He Hui's infantry were sent to Ze Prefecture, and Gong was ordered to supervise them.

sentences.zh: 世宗親征，拱以精騎居陣中。

translations.literal: When Shizong personally campaigned, Gong with picked cavalry occupied the center of the array.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong led the campaign in person, Gong placed his picked cavalry at the center of the battle line.

sentences.zh: 高平之捷，以功兼義成軍節度、河東行營前軍都監。

translations.literal: At the victory of Gaoping, for merit he concurrently held the Yicheng military governorship and was front-army commander of the Hedong campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: After the victory at Gaoping he was given the Yicheng military governorship for his service and made front-army commander of the Hedong campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 師還，出鎮陳州。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he went out to govern Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was sent out to govern Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 先是，晉末，秦州節度何建以秦、成、階三州入蜀，蜀人又取鳳州。

translations.literal: Previously, at the end of Jin, Qin Prefecture military governor He Jian surrendered Qin, Cheng, and Jie prefectures to Shu; the Shu people also took Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the end of the Jin dynasty, He Jian, military governor of Qin Prefecture, had surrendered Qin, Cheng, and Jie to Shu, and the Shu armies had also taken Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至是，宰相王溥薦拱討之，乃召拱與鳳翔王景並率兵出大散關，連下城砦。

translations.literal: At this time Grand Chancellor Wang Pu recommended Gong to attack; Gong was summoned with Wang Jing of Fengxiang to lead troops together out of Dasan Pass, continuously taking cities and forts.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the grand chancellor Wang Pu recommended Gong for the campaign. Gong was summoned together with Wang Jing of Fengxiang, and their armies marched out through Dasan Pass, taking cities and forts in succession.

sentences.zh: 復命拱為西南面行營都監。

translations.literal: Gong was again appointed commander of the southwest campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was once more made commander of the southwestern campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 蜀人聞鳳州急，發卒五千餘出鳳州北堂倉鎮路，行至黃花谷，將絕周師糧道。

translations.literal: The Shu people, hearing Feng Prefecture was urgent, sent more than five thousand soldiers out along the Fengzhou Beitangcang town road; reaching Huanghuagu, they were about to cut off the Zhou army's supply route.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shu armies heard that Feng Prefecture was hard pressed, they sent more than five thousand men along the road from Beitangcang in Feng Prefecture. Reaching Huanghuagu, they prepared to cut the Zhou army's supply line.

sentences.zh: 拱與王景偵知之，命排陣使張建雄領兵二千直抵黃花谷，又遣別將領勁卒千人出敵後，截其歸路。

translations.literal: Gong and Wang Jing learned of it by reconnaissance; they ordered array commander Zhang Jianxiong to lead two thousand troops straight to Huanghuagu, also dispatched another commander leading a thousand crack troops out behind the enemy to intercept their return route.
translations.idiomatic: Gong and Wang Jing learned of the move through reconnaissance. They ordered the array commander Zhang Jianxiong to lead two thousand men straight to Huanghuagu and sent another commander with a thousand crack troops to get behind the enemy and cut off their retreat.

sentences.zh: 敵果為建雄所敗，奔堂倉，又為勁卒所逼，合勢掩擊，擒其監軍王巒、孫韜等千五百餘。

translations.literal: The enemy was indeed defeated by Jianxiong, fled to Tangcang, then pressed by the crack troops; combined force fell upon them and captured more than fifteen hundred including supervisors Wang Luan and Sun Tao.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy was indeed defeated by Jianxiong and fled toward Tangcang, where the crack troops pressed them from behind. The combined force fell on them and captured more than fifteen hundred men, including the supervisors Wang Luan and Sun Tao.

sentences.zh: 由是劍門之下，州邑營砦，望風宵遁，秦、鳳、階、成平。

translations.literal: Thereupon below Jianmen, prefectures, cities, camps, and forts fled at the wind by night; Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter every prefecture, city, camp, and fort below Jianmen fled at the first rumor of the Zhou advance. Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 召歸，宴於金祥殿。

translations.literal: Summoned back, he was feasted at the Jinxian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When he was recalled, he was feasted in the Jinxian Hall.

sentences.zh: 賜襲衣、金帶、銀器、繒帛、鞍勒馬。

translations.literal: He was granted court robes, gold belt, silver vessels, silk, saddle and bridled horses.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted court robes, a gold belt, silver vessels, silk, and a saddled horse.

sentences.zh: 顯德二年，世宗親征淮南，以拱權東京留守兼判開封府事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xiande, Shizong personally campaigned against Huainan; Gong was appointed acting eastern capital regent and concurrently judge of Kaifeng prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiande 2 Shizong personally campaigned against Huainan. Gong was appointed acting regent of the eastern capital and concurrently judge of Kaifeng prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 時揚州初平，南唐令境上出師，謀收復。

translations.literal: At the time Yang Prefecture had just been pacified; Southern Tang ordered troops on their border, plotting recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Prefecture had just been pacified, and Southern Tang ordered troops on its border, planning to recover the city.

sentences.zh: 韓令坤有棄城之意，即驛召拱赴行在，拜淮南節度，依前宣徽使兼緣江招討使，以令坤為副。

translations.literal: Han Lingkun had intent to abandon the city; immediately by post he summoned Gong to the temporary palace, appointing him Huainan military governor, continuing as palace commissioner and concurrently river pacification commissioner, with Lingkun as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Han Lingkun was ready to abandon the city. Gong was summoned by urgent post to the temporary palace, made military governor of Huainan, continued as palace commissioner and concurrently river pacification commissioner, with Lingkun as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 時周師久駐淮陽，都將趙晁、白廷遇等驕恣橫暴，不相稟從，惟務貪濫，至有劫人妻女者。

translations.literal: At the time the Zhou army had long encamped at Huaiyang; commanders Zhao Chao, Bai Tingyu and others were arrogant, tyrannical, and disobedient, concerned only with greed and excess—there were even those who robbed men's wives and daughters.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou army had long been encamped at Huaiyang, and commanders such as Zhao Chao and Bai Tingyu had grown arrogant, violent, and insubordinate, caring only for plunder—even seizing men's wives and daughters.

sentences.zh: 及拱至，戮其不奉法者數輩，軍中肅然。

translations.literal: When Gong arrived, he executed several of those who did not obey the law; the army was stern and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: When Gong arrived he executed several of the worst offenders, and the army at once became stern and disciplined.

sentences.zh: 六月，追敘秦、鳳功，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, retrospectively citing Qin and Feng merit, he was given the additional title of Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, in recognition of his Qin and Feng campaign, he was given the additional title of Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 時周師圍壽春經年未下，江、淮草寇充斥，吳援兵柵於紫金山，與城中烽火相應。

translations.literal: At the time the Zhou army besieged Shouchun for a year without taking it; river and Huai bandits filled the land; Wu relief troops fortified at Zijin Mountain, signaling with the city by beacon fires.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou army had besieged Shouchun for a year without taking it. Bandits filled the lands along the Yangzi and Huai, Wu relief troops fortified on Zijin Mountain, and beacon fires linked them to the city.

sentences.zh: 而舒、蘄、和、泰復為吳人所據。

translations.literal: And Su, Qi, He, and Tai were again held by Wu people.
translations.idiomatic: Su, Qi, He, and Tai had again fallen into Wu hands.

sentences.zh: 拱上言欲且徙揚州之師並力攻壽春，俟其城下，然後改圖進取。

translations.literal: Gong memorialized wishing temporarily to shift Yang Prefecture's army to combine force attacking Shouchun; wait until the city fell, then change plan for further advance.
translations.idiomatic: Gong memorialized that the army at Yang Prefecture should be shifted for the moment to concentrate on Shouchun, and that once the city fell they could turn to further advances.

sentences.zh: 世宗從之。

translations.literal: Shizong assented.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong agreed.

sentences.zh: 拱乃封庫，付揚州主者；

translations.literal: Gong then sealed the treasury and handed it to Yang Prefecture's chief officer;
translations.idiomatic: Gong sealed the treasury and handed it over to the chief officer at Yang Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 復遣本府牙將分部按巡城中。

translations.literal: He also sent the headquarters' military officers in divisions to patrol the city.
translations.idiomatic: and sent his headquarters officers in divisions to patrol the city.

sentences.zh: 秋毫不犯，軍民感悅。

translations.literal: Not the slightest autumn down was violated; soldiers and civilians were moved and delighted.
translations.idiomatic: His troops harmed not so much as a hair, and soldiers and civilians alike were deeply grateful.

sentences.zh: 及師行，吳人有負糗糧以送者。

translations.literal: When the army marched away, there were Wu people who carried dried provisions on their backs to see them off.
translations.idiomatic: When the army departed, Wu locals even came bearing dried rations on their backs to see them off.

sentences.zh: 至壽春，與李重進合勢以攻其城，改淮南道招討都監，敗淮南軍二千於黃蓍砦。

translations.literal: Reaching Shouchun, he combined forces with Li Chongjin to attack the city; he was changed to inspector-general of the Huainan Circuit pacification campaign and defeated two thousand Huainan troops at Huangqi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: At Shouchun he joined Li Chongjin in attacking the city, was made inspector-general of the Huainan pacification campaign, and routed two thousand Huainan troops at Huangqi Fort.

sentences.zh: 世宗再幸壽州，召拱宴賜甚厚，以為武寧軍節度，命領其屬駐鎮淮軍。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong again visited Shouchun in person; he summoned Gong to a banquet and bestowed lavish gifts, appointing him military governor of the Wuning Army and ordering him to lead his subordinates to garrison the Huai army.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong visited Shouchun again, he summoned Gong to a lavish banquet, made him military governor of Wuning, and ordered his forces to garrison the Huai front.

sentences.zh: 及克壽州，以功加同平章事、領武寧軍節度。

translations.literal: When Shouchun was taken, for his merit he was given the additional title of Tongpingzhangshi and continued as military governor of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: After Shouchun fell, he was made Tongpingzhangshi for his service while retaining the Wuning governorship.

sentences.zh: 四年，徙歸德軍節度。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to be military governor of the Guide Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to the Guide military governorship.

sentences.zh: 淮南平，改山南東道節度，俄充西南面水陸發運招討使。

translations.literal: When Huainan was pacified, he was changed to military governor of the Shannan East Circuit; shortly thereafter he served as commissioner for the southwest land-and-water transport and pacification campaign.
translations.idiomatic: After Huainan was pacified, he was made governor of Shannan East and soon after appointed commissioner for southwestern land-and-water transport and pacification.

sentences.zh: 恭帝即位。

translations.literal: Emperor Gong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gong took the throne.

sentences.zh: 加檢校太師、河南尹、西京留守。

translations.literal: He was given the additional titles of honorary Grand Preceptor, Intendant of Henan, and western capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: He was made honorary Grand Preceptor, Intendant of Henan, and regent of the western capital.

sentences.zh: 宋初，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song he was additionally made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the Song he was also made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 太祖征李筠，拱迎謁至汜水，言於上曰：“筠逆節久著，兵力日盛，陛下宜急濟大河，逾太行，乘其未集而誅之，緩則勢張，難為力矣。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizu campaigned against Li Jun, Gong came forward to pay respects as far as Sishui and said to the emperor: "Jun's rebellious conduct has long been evident, and his military strength grows daily. Your Majesty should promptly cross the great river, pass over the Taihang Mountains, and strike while his forces are not yet assembled. If you delay, his power will expand and he will be hard to overcome."
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu marched against Li Jun, Gong met him at Sishui and said, "Jun's rebellion has long been notorious, and his forces grow stronger by the day. Your Majesty should cross the Yellow River at once and pass the Taihang, striking before he can gather his strength. Wait, and he will become too powerful to handle."

sentences.zh: ”帝從其言，卷甲倍道趨之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his advice, stowed armor and doubled the marching pace to hurry there.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took his advice, stowed armor, and marched at double speed.

sentences.zh: 筠果率兵南向，聞車駕至，惶駭走澤州城守，遂見擒。

translations.literal: Jun indeed led troops south; hearing the imperial carriage had arrived, he was terrified and fled to garrison Ze Prefecture, and thus he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Jun did march south, but on learning the emperor was approaching he panicked, fled into Ze Prefecture to hold the city, and was soon captured.

sentences.zh: 乾德初，從郊祀畢，封譙國公。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qiande, after completing the suburban sacrifice, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qiande, after the suburban rites, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 拱尹河南十餘年，專治園林第舍，好聲妓，縱酒為樂，府政廢弛，群盜晝劫。

translations.literal: Gong served as Intendant of Henan for more than ten years, devoting himself exclusively to gardens and mansions; he loved music girls, indulged in wine for pleasure, neglected prefectural administration until it lapsed, and bandits plundered by day.
translations.idiomatic: As Intendant of Henan for more than ten years, Gong devoted himself to gardens and mansions, kept courtesans, drank for pleasure, neglected the prefecture until governance collapsed, and bandits robbed in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 太祖聞之怒，移鎮安州，命左武衛上將軍焦繼勳代之，謂繼勳曰：“洛久不治，選卿代之，無復效拱為也。”

translations.literal: Emperor Taizu heard of this and was angered; he transferred Gong to govern An Prefecture and ordered Left Military Guard General Jiao Jixun to replace him, saying to Jixun: "Luoyang has long gone ungoverned; I chose you to replace him—do not again act as Gong did."
translations.idiomatic: Taizu was furious when he heard. He transferred Gong to Anzhou and sent Left Military Guard General Jiao Jixun to replace him, saying, "Luoyang has been neglected for too long. I chose you to take over—do not repeat Gong's example."

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，進封秦國公，來朝，授左衛上將軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo he was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Qin; he came to court and was appointed Left Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Taiping Xingguo he was promoted to Duke of Qin, came to court, and was appointed Left Guard General.

sentences.zh: 八年，代王彥超判左金吾街仗事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he replaced Wang Yanchao as overseer of Left Golden Guard street ceremonial duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he replaced Wang Yanchao as overseer of Left Golden Guard street ceremonial duties.

sentences.zh: 表獻西京長夏門北園，詔以銀五千兩償之。

translations.literal: He memorialized offering the north garden outside Changxia Gate in the western capital; an edict compensated him with five thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: He offered the garden north of Changxia Gate in the western capital by memorial; the court compensated him with five thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，卒，年七十五。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi he died, aged seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi he died at seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 贈中書令。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted the title of Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，真宗聞拱之後有寒餒流離者，錄其孫懌為國子助教。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping, Emperor Zhenzong heard that among Gong's descendants there were people suffering cold, hunger, and displacement; he enrolled his grandson Yi as adjunct tutor at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xianping, Zhenzong learned that some of Gong's descendants were cold, hungry, and displaced, and enrolled his grandson Yi as adjunct tutor at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 拱子德明，至洛苑使；

translations.literal: Gong's son Deming rose to the post of Luoyuan Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Gong's son Deming rose to Luoyuan Commissioner;

sentences.zh: 昱，大中祥符八年進士出身。

translations.literal: Yu passed the jinshi examination in the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu.
translations.idiomatic: Yu received his jinshi degree in the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu.

sentences.zh: 德明子悅，為虞部郎中。

translations.literal: Deming's son Yue served as a department director in the Bureau of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Deming's son Yue served as a department director in the Bureau of Works.

sentences.zh: 王彥超

translations.literal: Wang Yanchao
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchao

sentences.zh: 王彥超，大名臨清人。

translations.literal: Wang Yanchao was a native of Linqing in Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchao was from Linqing in Daming.

sentences.zh: 性溫和恭謹，能禮下土。

translations.literal: His disposition was gentle, mild, respectful, and careful, and he was able to treat men of lower rank with courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: He was gentle, respectful, and careful by nature, and knew how to treat men of lower rank with courtesy.

sentences.zh: 少事後唐魏王繼岌，從繼岌討蜀，還至渭南。

translations.literal: In his youth he served Later Tang's Prince of Wei, Ji Gu; he followed Ji Gu in the campaign against Shu and returned as far as Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he served Later Tang's Prince of Wei, Ji Gu, followed him against Shu, and returned as far as Weinan.

sentences.zh: 會明宗即位，繼岌遇害，左右遁去，彥超乃依鳳翔重雲山僧舍暉道人為徒。

translations.literal: When Emperor Mingzong ascended the throne, Ji Gu met with disaster; his attendants fled, and Yanchao took refuge with the monk Hui at the Chongyun Mountain temple in Fengxiang as his disciple.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne, Ji Gu was killed; his attendants scattered, and Yanchao took refuge with the monk Hui at the Chongyun Mountain temple in Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 暉善觀人，謂彥超曰：“子，富貴人也，安能久居此？

translations.literal: Hui was skilled at reading people and said to Yanchao: "You are a man destined for wealth and honor—how can you long remain here?"
translations.idiomatic: Hui was a keen judge of character and told Yanchao, "You are a man destined for wealth and honor. How can you stay here long?"

sentences.zh: ”給資帛遣之。

translations.literal: He provided funds and cloth and sent him off.
translations.idiomatic: He gave him money and cloth and sent him on his way.

sentences.zh: 時晉祖帥陝，乃召至帳下，委以心腹。

translations.literal: At that time the Jin founder commanded Shaanxi; he summoned Yanchao to his tent and entrusted him as a trusted confidant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin founder commanded Shaanxi, he summoned Yanchao to his headquarters and treated him as a trusted confidant.

sentences.zh: 及移鎮太原，將引兵南下，遣從事桑維翰求援契丹，以彥超從行。

translations.literal: When he transferred his garrison to Taiyuan and was about to lead troops south, he dispatched his aide Sang Weihan to seek aid from the Khitan, with Yanchao accompanying the mission.
translations.idiomatic: When he moved his garrison to Taiyuan and prepared to march south, he sent his aide Sang Weihan to seek Khitan aid, with Yanchao in attendance.

sentences.zh: 天福初，累遷奉德軍校，再轉殿前散指揮都虞候、領蒙州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu he was repeatedly promoted to officer of the Fengde Army, then again transferred to deputy commander of the Palace Front scattered command and concurrently prefect of Meng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianfu he rose through the Fengde Army, then became deputy commander of the Palace Front scattered command while also serving as prefect of Meng.

sentences.zh: 漢初，領岳州防禦使兼護聖左廂都校，出為復州防禦使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han he held the post of defense commissioner of Yue Prefecture and concurrently commander of the Left Wing of the Guard Sacred Army; he was then sent out as defense commissioner of Fu Prefecture.
